thought: The stove is already on, but neither pot is on it. Grasp moka_pot_2 to begin moving it to the cook region.
Moka pot 2 is grasped but still contacts the table; lift it before moving to the stove.
Moka pot 2 is held and lifted; transport it to the stove cooking region before placement.
Moka pot 2 is held above the cook region after successful transport; place it before handling the other pot.
Only moka_pot_1 remains off the stove. Grasp it by the handle to begin moving it to the cook region.
Moka pot 1 is grasped but not yet lifted. Lift it before transporting to the stove; the other pot and stove activation goals are already satisfied.
Moka pot 1 is held and lifted. Transport it to the cook region; pot 2 is already on the stove and the stove is on.
The previous transport was rejected for IK or collision. Moka pot 1 remains held; lift it further before retrying transport to the occupied stove.
The additional lift provides a recovery opportunity after the rejected transport. Retry moving the held pot to the cook region; the other pot and stove already satisfy their goals.
Transport succeeded after the recovery lift. Place the held moka pot in the cook region; the other pot and stove-on goals are already satisfied.
The first pot fell outside the cook region after release. Regrasp it from the top to recover with a different grasp; the stove is already on.
Neither pot is on the stove, which is already on. Retry grasping the released first pot with a handle approach after the top grasp failed.
